items.description: An outbound egress guard for agents — scan any message (email, social draft, Telegram reply, a write to a public site) for leaked secrets and private identifiers before it goes out, and either refuse it or redact them in place. Pure standard library, precision-tuned to not cry wolf.

latestVersion.changelog:
sluice 1.0.0 — Initial public release

- Scans outbound messages for leaked secrets and private identifiers before sending.
- Blocks or redacts detected credentials including API keys, tokens, JWTs, and private keys.
- Supports gating and redacting modes with machine-readable output and customizable thresholds.
- Pure Python standard library: no dependencies, no external network calls.
- Designed for high precision, minimizing false positives.
- Easy integration as a pre-send guard for agents publishing to email, social, or public sites.

items.description: A pluggable pipe filter that strips verbose CLI output (huge YAML/JSON dumps, lockfiles, long diffs) before it reaches the LLM, so an agent spends its context budget on signal, not noise. Lossless cleanups always-on; large dumps clamped to head+tail with a clear elision marker.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of slim: a pluggable pipe filter for cleaning up verbose CLI output before reaching agents.
- Strips ANSI color codes, trims whitespace, collapses blank lines, and compresses repeated lines (lossless filters always on).
- Clamps large outputs to head+tail with a clear elision marker, tuned per command (e.g., YAML/JSON, long diffs, logs).
- Outputs filtered data to stdout and, with --report, prints a savings summary to stderr.
- Designed for use in agent pipelines to save context budget; can be extended via plugins.

items.description: Build a compact local SQLite index of every function, class, method, interface and type across your repos, so an agent finds a symbol's file:line and signature in one lookup instead of a tree-wide grep plus whole-file read.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of codemap.

- Build a local SQLite index of all functions, classes, methods, interfaces, and types in your code repositories for fast symbol lookup.
- Supports Python (functions, classes, methods) and JS/TS/JSX/TSX (function declarations, exported arrow consts, classes, interfaces, type aliases).
- CLI tool enables building, querying, and outlining indexed code symbols with a single command.
- Pure Python implementation with no network, model calls, or external dependencies required.
- Skips common directories like node_modules, .git, and dist during indexing.
- Designed to reduce redundant file scans and token usage for agents working across large projects.

items.description: Local web search skill that runs entirely on the user's machine. Scrapes DuckDuckGo / Bing / Google HTML directly with automatic engine fallback (DDG -> Bing -> Google). Use whenever the user needs real-time web information, latest news, or content beyond the knowledge cutoff. Returns structured results (url / name / snippet / host_name / rank / date / favicon) plus source_engine, raw_html, score extensions. Supports --num, --recency-days, --locale (BCP-47), --json, --output. No API key, no SDK, no cloud hop.
